name: Naruto
pageTitle: Naruto Anime to Manga Converter | Naruto & Shippuden | Anime2Manga
lede: Choose Naruto or Naruto: Shippuden, then enter a manga volume, chapter, or anime episode to find the matching point in the other format.
seoCopy: Match Naruto and Naruto: Shippuden anime episodes with manga chapters and volumes, identify filler, and find exactly where to continue reading.
footer: Naruto covers episodes 1–220; Naruto: Shippuden covers episodes 1–500.
The manga lookup covers all 72 volumes and chapters 1–700.
Episodes adapted from official novels are identified separately when no manga chapter applies.
Sources: episode–chapter correspondence from ListFist; volume data and ISBNs cross-checked with Wikipedia and VIZ Media; volume covers served by VIZ Media.
beyondDataHint: The complete Naruto manga and both TV anime series are included.
